card.name: Android 17, Infinite Rotation
card.skill:
[auto][limit 1]{r}, if your Leader is a red ≪Android≫ card: At the end of a battle in which your Battle Card attacked, play this card from under a {Destroyed West City} in your Battle Area.
[auto][limit 1] When this card in your hand is placed under a {Destroyed West City} in your Battle Area, place up to 1 red card from your deck under a Z-Extra in your Battle Area, then shuffle your deck.

card.name: Abducted
card.skill:
[permanent] Negate the skills of Battle Cards on top of this card, and those cards can't attack.
[activate: main] Choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with in its character name and place this card under it from your Drop after this card is activated.
[activate: main]{2}: Place this card in your Drop from under a Battle Card with in its character name.

card.name: SSB Son Goku & SSB Vegeta, Battle With a God
card.skill:
[Deflect][Dual Attack]
[Permanent] If your Leader is a black <Son Goku>-only card and you have 3 or more energy, reduce the energy cost of this card in your Z-Deck by {b}{w}.
[Auto] When this card is played, send up to 1 card from your Drop to its owner's Warp.
[Auto][Limit 1] When this card is placed under a <Vegito> card with a [Union] skill, choose up to 1 of your cards and switch it to Revealed Mode.

card.name: Lightning Speed Vegito
card.skill:
[Union-Potara] ③: <Son Goku> and <Vegeta> (Place this card in Active Mode on top of the 2 specified cards stacked together)
[Permanent] This card can attack Battle Cards that are in Active Mode.
[Auto] At the end of the battle after this card attacks, place 10 cards from the top of your deck in your Drop Area. Then, choose up to 1 <Vegito> with 25000 power from your Drop Area and evolve into it by placing it on top of this card in Active Mode.

qa.q: You use [Union-Potara] to play a card on top of a card that received +5000 power and [Double Strike] for the duration of the turn. Do these power boosts and skills transfer to the new card?
qa.a: The new card retains the +5000 power boost, but does not receive [Double Strike]. When playing cards on top of other cards, only changes to power transfer. Any skills granted to the cards placed below do not.

qa.q: Can you attack your own Battle Cards in Active Mode?
Can you evolve into {BT2-012 Repeated Force Vegito} with {BT2-013 Lightning Speed Vegito}’s skill?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
{BT2-012 Repeated Force Vegito} has 25000 power, and its character name is "Vegito," so the specified conditions are fulfilled.

qa.q: Do you need to pay the energy cost or [Evolve] cost for cards evolved via card skills?
qa.a: No, you do not need to pay the unless specified otherwise.
